_comment: Schema.org Person fields emitted as JSON-LD by components/PersonSchema.jsx. Name and site URL come from data/site.json. Two deliberate omissions: no 'alumniOf' (that would assert a completed degree; Roshan is a current student, so 'affiliation' alone is correct) and no 'jobTitle' (it implies employment — 'description' carries the research framing instead). sameAs is listed explicitly here because it must contain identity profiles ONLY; deriving it from site.json footerLinks wrongly swept in the source-code repo.
